weeks.content:
God's design for work - Adam in the Garden (Genesis 2:15);
work (2 Thessalonians 3:10-12); The ant's example

weeks.content:
Meaning of moderation - balance, self-control, avoiding
1 Peter 4:7); Temperance as fruit of the Spirit (Galatians

Avoiding addiction and excess

weeks.topic: Moderation in Christian Life II Moderation in sleep - neither too much nor too little;
weeks.content:
Moderation in speech (James 3:1-12, Ephesians 4:29);
Balanced use of technology and social media; Moderation
in spending and material possessions; Self-discipline (1

Assessment of topics covered in weeks 1-4

weeks.topic: Temptation and Corruption I Temptation is not sin (Hebrews 4:15); Sources of temptation
weeks.content:
Understanding temptation - meaning and sources;
- the devil, the world, the flesh (1 John 2:15-17); Jesus'
temptation in the wilderness (Matthew 4:1-11); Common
temptations for young people - lying, cheating, stealing,
disobedience, immorality, pride; How temptation works
(James 1:13-15)

weeks.topic: Temptation and Corruption II God (Psalm 119:11), flee from temptation (1 Corinthians
weeks.content:
Resisting temptation - prayer (Matthew 26:41), Word of
6:18, 2 Timothy 2:22), accountability and fellowship;
Joseph resisting Potiphar's wife (Genesis 39:7-12); God
provides a way of escape (1 Corinthians 10:13); Victory
through Christ; Building spiritual strength

Understanding corruption - meaning, types, forms; Biblical
teaching against corruption - bribes (Exodus 23:8), dishonest
gain (Proverbs 15:27), theft (Exodus 20:15); Examples of
corruption in the Bible - Gehazi (2 Kings 5:20-27), Judas
(Matthew 26:14-16), Ananias and Sapphira (Acts 5:1-11);
Consequences of corruption

Integrity in Christian life - Daniel's example (Daniel 6:3-5),
Joseph's honesty (Genesis 39:1-9); Standing against
corruption; Being honest in all dealings; Reporting
corruption; The cost of integrity; Long-term rewards of
honesty; Building a reputation of trustworthiness; Being salt
and light (Matthew 5:13-16); Preparing to face corruption in
secondary school and society
